ambiguity_threshold_rule: Flag on ambiguity alone only when strictly more than half the candidate readings find a fault. Swept on development from one sixth to one when the threshold was fitted: every threshold at or below 0.5 flagged all 143 ambiguity-only invoices, of which 142 were clean: 142 false positives to gain one detection. Every observed error fraction is exactly 0.5, so the sweep is decided at that point and the chosen rule is the majority-of-readings default.
event: flag correct and expected cents exact, on the development partition of Hospital 1
limitations: No Hospital 2-5 labels exist. Their confidence is the fitted Hospital 1 value reduced by a tenth, which is a policy judgment and never transferred empirical accuracy.
A tier seen fewer than 30 times on development is held at the level of the weaker tier rather than fitted to its own small sample.
The development partition shares global utilisation with the check partition, so it is not an independent external test.
